bloodlines.arcana: After casting a spell with the darkness descriptor or shadow subschool, gain a circumstance bonus on Stealth equal to its spell level for 1d4 rounds.

powers.name: Shadowstrike
powers.summary: Make a melee touch attack for 1d4 nonlethal damage plus 1 per two sorcerer levels and dazzle the target for 1 minute. Uses per day equal 3 + Charisma modifier.

powers.name: Nighteye
powers.summary: Gain darkvision 30 feet, increasing to 60 feet at 9th level; if you already have darkvision, extend its range by those amounts.

powers.name: Shadow Well
powers.summary: Hide near shadows while observed and switch places with a willing ally in dim light or darkness; at 13th level switch two allies, with additional daily uses at levels 17 and 20.

powers.name: Enveloping Darkness
powers.summary: Once per day create deeper darkness that you can see through and that entangles every other creature lacking freedom of movement.

powers.name: Shadow Master
powers.summary: See perfectly in natural or magical darkness, make shadow conjuration and evocation effects 20% more real, and grant Augment Summoning to creatures they create.

bloodlines.arcana: Targets that fail saves against your evocation spells are dazzled by starlight for 1 round per spell level.

powers.name: Minute Meteors
powers.summary: Call tiny meteorites into a 5-foot column within 30 feet for 1d4 fire damage plus 1 per two sorcerer levels, negated by Reflex. Uses per day equal 3 + Charisma modifier.

powers.name: Voidwalker
powers.summary: Gain low-light vision plus cold and fire resistance 5; at 9th level you no longer need to breathe.

powers.name: Aurora Borealis
powers.summary: Create a cold-damage wall of fire whose chosen side fascinates nearby creatures, for rounds per day equal to your sorcerer level.

powers.name: Breaching the Gulf
powers.summary: Cast teleportation spells at +3 caster level and once per day exile a creature within 30 feet to an airless void until it succeeds on a Will save to return.

powers.name: Starborn
powers.summary: Gain immunity to cold and blindness, see perfectly in all darkness, and gain fast healing 1 while outdoors at night.
